Allowed origins are controlled by the `cors()` middleware in `worker/src/index.ts` (lines 19–31). It's a function-based `origin` check (needed because Hono's array matching doesn't support wildcards) that allows:

- `http://localhost:4200` (exact match)
- any `*.pages.dev` subdomain
- any `*.workers.dev` subdomain

To add a new custom domain, edit the `origin` callback in `worker/src/index.ts` (~line 24), adding another condition, e.g.:

```ts
origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com' ||
```

(or an `.endsWith('.your-domain.com')` check for subdomains), inside the `if (...)` block before `return origin;`. This is documented in `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` §4 "CORS".
